product_family: Workflow automation and AI orchestration platform (Zaps/workflows, Tables, Interfaces, Canvas, AI Agents, Chatbots, Zapier MCP, Zapier SDK, Zapier Enterprise governance layer)

certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 (TYPE II) ... Zapier is pleased to announce that we have successfully completed our 2024 SOC2 Type II audit, which covers the period from May 1, 2023, to May 31, 2024.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence Zapier itself holds ISO/IEC 27001. Search results indicate the SOC 2/ISO 27001 references found relate to Zapier's underlying infrastructure providers' own certifications, not a Zapier-held ISO 27001 certificate; Zapier's trust center and security-compliance page list only SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3, GDPR, and CCPA.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a Zapier-held PCI DSS attestation. Not listed on the Trust Center badges (SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3, GDPR, CCPA) or the security-compliance marketing page.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management systems)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence. Not listed among Trust Center badges or the security-compliance page's certification claims.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR registration or self-assessment for Zapier. Not listed on the Trust Center or security-compliance page.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP authorization. Not listed on the Trust Center or security-compliance page.

certifications.name: GDPR (posture)
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR + CCPA COMPLIANT ... GDPR: Data privacy compliance ... comply with GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy regulations. Zapier will enter into a DPA (Data Processing Addendum available at zapier.com/legal/data-processing-addendum).

privacy.ai_training_note: Trains on customer content by default for non-Enterprise plans; opt-out is available and Enterprise is auto-opted-out. Per Zapier's own security-compliance messaging: 'Enterprise customers are automatically opted out of data training. Customers on other plans can opt out by filling out the opt-out form.' Zapier also states: 'For customers who've opted out using a simple form and all Enterprise customers (who are opted out automatically), none of your content will ever be used by Zapier or our partners to train AI models or to improve our services.' Non-Enterprise, non-opted-out customer content can be used for training or service improvement by default, on the Free, Starter, Professional, Team, and Company plans.
privacy.data_region: Not confirmed as configurable or selectable; Zapier is a US-headquartered company (Zapier Inc.) offering GDPR/UK GDPR-compliant international data transfer mechanisms (a Data Transfer Impact Assessment referenced in its legal docs) rather than a customer-selectable data-residency region like some enterprise SaaS competitors.

security.name: Third-party audits
security.value: One or more annual third-party audit(s); annual third-party penetration testing (2025 HackerOne penetration test report listed as a Trust Center document).

security.name: Bug bounty / vulnerability disclosure
security.value: Has a bug bounty or vulnerability disclosure program; 'Report a Vulnerability' quick link on the Trust Center.

security.name: Subprocessors transparency
security.value: Public, actively maintained subprocessors list with dated change-log announcements (e.g. Grafana Labs added, Bright Data removed, June 2026; Fireworks AI added as an AI subprocessor, May 2026).

security.name: SSO / provisioning
security.value: SAML-based SSO and SCIM user provisioning available (Enterprise tier).

security.name: Cyber insurance
security.value: Has cyber insurance; Certificate of Insurance listed as a Trust Center document.

security.name: Disaster recovery
security.value: Annual Disaster Recovery (DR) test documented and made available on the Trust Center.

security.name: Data deletion
security.value: Deletes customer data on request (per Trust Center Quick Summary).

security.name: AI governance / access controls (Enterprise)
security.value: Action Restrictions, Managed Connections (company-owned, IT-managed app connections), Domain Restrictions, App Access Controls, Bring Your Own Model (BYOM, e.g. run through customer's own Amazon Bedrock), AI Guardrails (blocks sensitive data / risky inputs), Log Streaming to Datadog/Splunk, centralized audit trail for every AI action.

security.name: Status page
security.value: Has a status page (per Trust Center Quick Summary).

products.name: Zapier Free / Starter / Professional / Team / Company (core Zaps, Tables, Interfaces, Canvas)
products.data_scope: Connects 9,000+ third-party apps; processes whatever workflow data the customer routes through it. Customer content may be used to train AI models / improve services unless the customer submits the opt-out form.
products.notes: No admin console-grade governance (SSO/SCIM, action restrictions, BYOM) at these tiers; those are Enterprise-only. Not eligible for BAAs/PHI use at any tier.

products.name: Zapier Enterprise
products.category: Enterprise AI orchestration / IT governance layer
products.data_scope: Adds SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, workspaces, action/domain/app access restrictions, managed connections, BYOM (route AI through customer's own infrastructure e.g. Bedrock), AI Guardrails, log streaming, full audit trail via Asset History API. Automatically opted out of AI training on customer content.
products.notes: Target tier for regulated/large-org buyers; this is the tier where the trust-center certifications (SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3) and the automatic AI-training opt-out actually apply operationally alongside governance controls.

products.name: Zapier MCP
products.category: AI agent / assistant connectivity (Claude, ChatGPT, any MCP client)
products.data_scope: Lets external AI assistants (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT) call Zapier-governed actions across 9,000+ apps through one authenticated, audited connection.
products.notes: Same underlying auth, policy, and audit-trail layer as Zapier SDK; IT sees and controls both surfaces identically per Zapier's own product messaging.

products.name: Zapier SDK / CLI
products.category: Developer platform for building custom AI apps and integrations
products.data_scope: Used by developers/coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) to build custom integrations against the same governed connection layer as MCP.
products.notes: Shares Zapier's runtime, credential handling, and audit logging with the rest of the platform.

products.name: Zapier Desk (zapierdesk.com) — SEPARATE, UNAFFILIATED same-name company, NOT a Zapier Inc. product
products.category: Unrelated third-party help-desk product (name collision only)
products.data_scope: Operates on its own domain (zapierdesk.com) with its own head office and contact (contact@zapierdesk.com); discloses no ownership, parent, or legal-entity relationship to Zapier Inc. (zapier.com). Claims its own ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 27001:2022.
products.notes: This entry disambiguates the source of stray 'Zapier ISO 27001' search results. This is a different company; its ISO 27001:2022 does not apply to Zapier Inc.'s automation platform. Zapier Inc.'s own product family, per zapier.com and its Trust Center, does not include a 'Zapier Desk' product.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium SaaS subscription, per-task/per-user tiers (Free, Starter, Professional, Team, Company) plus custom-priced Enterprise; no self-host option.
compare.data_residency: Not confirmed as customer-selectable; US-based company with GDPR/UK GDPR cross-border transfer mechanisms documented in its legal terms, but no evidence of choosable regional data residency (e.g. EU-only hosting).

flags: Non-Enterprise customer content is used to train AI models or improve services by default unless the customer submits an opt-out form; only Enterprise is auto-opted-out. This is a meaningful distinction from a blanket 'does not train on data' claim.

Zapier states on its own blog that it is not HIPAA compliant and does not sign a BAA on any plan. Third-party integrations or consultants claiming 'HIPAA-compliant Zapier workflows' (e.g. HIPAAtizer) are wrapper products, not Zapier itself.

The stray ISO 27001 references surface from Zapier's underlying infrastructure providers' own certifications (the host, not the vendor), and from 'Zapier Desk' at zapierdesk.com, a separate, unaffiliated company with the same name (its own domain, head office, and contact, with no disclosed ownership link to Zapier Inc.), not a Zapier product. Neither can be credited to Zapier Inc. Zapier's own Trust Center and security-compliance page list only SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3, GDPR, and CCPA.

Zapier's marketing surface (homepage, security-compliance page) emphasizes broad 'AI governance and security' language that could be read as implying deeper compliance coverage (e.g. HIPAA-adjacent 'AI Guardrails' for 'sensitive data') than the trust center actually documents; only SOC 2 Type II, SOC 3, GDPR, and CCPA are backed by trust-center badges/documents.
